title: COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador
summary: The English Wikipedia article "COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador", at revision 1371474249, opens: "The COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador was a part of the worldwide pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2. The virus was reported to have spread to Ecuador on 29 February 2020, when a woman in her 70s tested positive for the virus. Ecuador was described in April as emerging as a possible "epicentre" of the pandemic in Latin America, with the city of Guayaquil overwhelmed to the point where bodies were being left in the street." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q87250713, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "viral pandemic in Ecuador". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
